Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Jain
 Order

1. Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No.271/2025 dated 30.06.2025, registered at P.S. Maurya Enclave, for commission of offences under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, along with all consequential proceedings arising therefrom, on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.
2. It is informed that parties are not present today.
